## Reading

- 186 (track, node end) rows; no `copy/row node`, no `none` kind, no crossing in a structure with a copy.
- Diverging legs (the track leaving a split or arriving at a merge as the non-straight leg) nearly always step: 59 of 61 (split 29 of 30, merge 30 of 31); the two exceptions: a split diverging leg with a crossing as other end, a merge diverging leg with a node as other end.
- Straight legs mostly do not: 16 of 61 step (split 6 of 30, merge 10 of 31); with a crossing as other end only 1 of 16 at a split and 9 of 25 at a merge.
- Trunks (leaving a merge, arriving at a split) never step when the other end is a crossing (0 of 20); with a node 13 of 27, with a port 9 of 15.
- Fork legs: 1 of 2 steps. Kinds: fray diverging 8 of 8; join diverging 20 of 20; lane split diverging 21 of 22; lane merge diverging 10 of 11; every other kind x role has both outcomes.
- Mixed rows (both step and no step): 10 of 16 in dir x role x other end, 7 of 7 in dir x role, 4 of 4 by node kind, 11 of 13 in kind x dir x role.
